description: Indicateurs de correction climatique sur le réseau GRDF is a dataset listed in GRDF open data portal, an open data portal of a gas distribution operator, published or maintained by GRDF. Ce jeu de données permet de suivre les quantités mensuelles de gaz acheminées sur le réseau de distribution de GRDF depuis les points d'interface avec le transport ainsi que la correction climatique associée. Il permet de suivre l’évolution des consommations acheminées par GRDF à climat réel et à climat « moyen » sur différents périmètres. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Consommation. Its keywords are correction climatique, gaz. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-grdf-open-data-portal.
